summary: RenovoRx, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to announce its participation in a JonesTrading virtual key opinion leader webinar on August 13, 2026, focused on pancreatic cancer and its TAMP platform. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 details the webinar agenda, including the Phase III TIGeR-PaC trial and RenovoCath commercial launch. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review is involved; the filing is a routine disclosure of an upcoming investor-relations webinar.
